method.gate: recovered theta must equal 0.75*beta within 1e-8 for every N and beta

diagnosis.model_011_indicator: FUTURE_REASSIGNED AND future != profile AND action == future
diagnosis.mismatch: The frozen DGP applies beta to all FUTURE_REASSIGNED permutation-aligned cells, including the 24 fixed-point cells. Model-011's primary signal indicator explicitly removes those fixed-point cells.
diagnosis.implication: The 0.75 factor is the fraction of non-identity permutation-profile pairs, but it is not sufficient to define the population coefficient recovered by the Model-011 likelihood under the frozen DGP.
diagnosis.why_nuisance_does_not_fix_it: The fixed-point contribution varies with permutation membership and is not fully represented by the model's permutation-invariant nuisance terms; the fitted signal coefficient therefore absorbs part of the omitted fixed-point contribution.

conclusion: The proposed exact mapping theta_DGP = 0.75*beta is NOT recovered by the independent population audit. Model-011 is not yet validated as the estimator of the declared DGP estimand.
next_gate: Do not authorize or rerun Monte Carlo. Reconcile the fixed-point semantics: either extend Model-011 to represent the fixed-point FUTURE_REASSIGNED signal explicitly, or revise/freeze a DGP whose signal is restricted to non-identity mappings. Then repeat an independent population DGP-to-estimand equivalence audit before any power execution.
